summary: First-party English and Yoruba-oriented discovery identified Ogun State's OLARMS and OLARMS-GIS/GeoSense Pro services. The public map landing page exposes only an OSM basemap and redirects full GIS access to login; no anonymous parcel ID, schema, CRS, or geometry was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries and bounded GET checks, including the current JavaScript/configuration, public API base, 404 API root, login wall, and absence of an exposed public parcel feature response, are recorded in city-3229-ago-iwoye.json.
registryCustodian: Ogun State Land Administration and Revenue Management System (OLARMS), with Ogun State Bureau of Lands and Survey / land-administration authorities
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [6.94549138001476, 3.9237345233283] was preserved and not moved.
Authentication wall and absence of a public map/API response are not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
Official OLARMS/OLARMS-GIS capability statements do not establish open vector coverage at Ago-Iwoye.
No unsafe personal, ownership, contact, title, tax/account, or certificate fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, or coverage qualification.
Independent serial review is required before adapter/runtime qualification.

qualification.reason: Research established the local/state custodian but not safe public parcel feature access.
